notes: Encoded independently from this page's own text only; no usesStylesOf and nothing imported from any Nordyne-family or Westinghouse file, even though the page header says 'Same as Westinghouse' and lists Nordyne-family sister brands. Parent as stated on the page: Nortek (formerly Nordyne Manufacturing). COUNTING CONVENTION fixed by this page's own Style 1 example: digit-only counting is falsified (digits of FGA030310579 give year '31', which resolves to no year: 1931 below the 1960 floor, 2031 future), so character counting ships for all styles. Style 5 is shipped as ONE merged style with a dual-candidate table (see its notes) rather than two colliding same-shape styles; flagged as a judgment call in the report.

styles.notes: Page positions 4-5 = year, 6-7 = month (1-based characters, converted to [3,5] and [5,7]). Character counting: '03' year, '03' month. Digit-only counting is falsified by this example (see brand notes).

Page positions 3-4 = year (1-based characters, converted to [2,4]) = '89' resolving to 1989. Page example shown as 'F3891 4228'; the space is stripped by normalization and the page itself says the space is not counted. No month is stated for this style, so it ships year-only. Character counting follows the page convention fixed by Style 1; digit-only counting would give 1991 and is not a live alternative once that convention is fixed.

styles.era: 12-character serials, letter + digit + letter + 9 digits (page Style 3)
styles.notes: Page positions 4-5 = year, 6-7 = month (1-based characters on the normalized serial, dash stripped, converted to [3,5] and [5,7]) = '99' year, '05' month. Digit-only counting is falsified here too (it would give month '50', invalid). Page example shown as G6R9905-05028.

Page: year = 7th & 8th digits (the first two numbers following the dash) = '97' in the raw form, i.e. normalized positions [5,7]; month = last (9th) character, a letter whose mapping is chart image only, held. Ships year-only. Page example shown as 21584-97B; dash stripped by normalization.

styles.era: 6-character serials, letter + 5 digits (page Style 5, two era-bounded sub-styles merged)
styles.notes: MERGED DUAL-CANDIDATE STYLE (judgment call, see report): the page lists this shape twice, once used exclusively January 1980 through December 1984 (example M38778, year digit '3') and once January 1970 through December 1979 (example A16789, year digit '1'). Shipping the two eras as two styles would collide on the identical pattern with different decodes for digits 0-4, so they are merged into one explicit digit-keyed table: digits 0-4 map to candidate pairs [1970,1980] through [1974,1984] and digits 5-9 map singly to 1975-1979. This is an honest ambiguous result, not a guess, and follows the schema's dual-candidate provision; the single-digit-year policy is satisfied because both era bounds are stated on this page. Month in both eras is the 1st letter digit, chart image only, held for the image pass. Example M38778 must carry the full candidate list.
